name: Pearl Harbor Aviation Museum — Hangar 37
scope: Model the historic hangar exterior, roof and glazing. Research exact footprint and current museum modifications; no aircraft models are implied.
era: surviving exterior represented by selected dated references

review.method: Explicit owner acceptance of remaining approximate entrance detail; verified public-domain historic main-volume reference.
review.notes: Owner asked to bless the three remaining models as good enough and continue. Historic Navy reference and mapped footprint support main volume. Modern canopy details remain estimates. Earlier private/attribution-only imagery excluded.

originalReview.primaryCredit: Official U.S. Navy Photograph, now in the collections of the National Archives.
originalReview.notes: Previously inspected entire original published archive JPEG. Explicitly identifies Hangar37 and supports historic roof,ventilation,door track and main volume. Does not verify later museum entrance; owner explicitly accepts that approximate exterior detail.
